notes: Phobos Manufacturing gas store families, small size (2 x 2). Every store uses the game's own RTA canister vessel (0.787 m3 at 41.4 MPa and 293 K, about 13,400 mol of ideal gas), authored at an 80% fill in a 160 kg housing; hydrogen is authored lower and ammonia is kept liquefied (609 kg/m3 at 20 C, Engineering ToolBox after NIST). Medium and large sizes scale through the Framework ladder. Changing a capacity or dry mass leaves existing stores Protected until accepted. Sources: docs/development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md.

PhobosHydrogenStore.notes: Fennmark H2: 24 kg of usable hydrogen; leaks to space (no room species).

PhobosMethaneStore.notes: Fennmark M2: about 200 kg fits at the rating; authored 160 kg.

PhobosOxygenStore.notes: Fennmark O2: 80% of the ideal-gas moles as oxygen.

PhobosNitrogenStore.notes: Fennmark N2: 80% of the ideal-gas moles as nitrogen.

PhobosCarbonDioxideStore.notes: Fennmark C2: 80% of the ideal-gas moles as carbon dioxide (real CO2 would be a denser fluid; the game treats every gas as ideal).

PhobosAmmoniaStore.notes: Fennmark Q2: liquefied ammonia at an 80% fill, 383 kg rounded to 380.
